verdict.rationale: Missive publishes its own REST API endpoint reference with per-endpoint example requests against https://public.missiveapp.com/v1/, which users can copy and run. The same evidence states there is no live try-it runner and no OpenAPI spec, and probes confirm every OpenAPI path returns 404, so the reference is static rather than interactive. missing for 10: an in-browser interactive try-it console, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec for generating runnable examples, and hands-on corroboration that the examples run as written.
